environment.description: Actix-web service deployed on an EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023) running in a VPC with IMDSv1 enabled. The instance has an IAM role attached with S3 and Secrets Manager read access. No network egress filtering. SELinux is in permissive mode (default for container-optimized AMI). The service runs as a systemd unit under the default unconfined_t SELinux context.
